### problem 1: variable packet size  {.smaller}

![](/queuing/texfig/fair-queue-setup-problem-1-variable-packet-size.figure.svg)
 

* just alternating packets doesn't work with variable sizes
* need to send more packets from flows with faster packets


### problem 2: packets arriving late  {.smaller}

<tr><td>time =</td><td>queue</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td></td><td>A1, B1, B2, B3</td><td></td></tr>
<tr><td>0.0</td><td>B1, B2, B3</td><td>start sending A1</td></tr>
<tr><td>1.0</td><td>B1, B2, B3</td><td>finish sending A1</td></tr>
<tr><td>1.0</td><td>B2, B3</td><td>start sending B1</td></tr>
<tr><td>2.0</td><td>B2, B3</td><td>finish sending B1</td></tr>
<tr><td>2.0</td><td>B3</td><td>start sending B2</td></tr>
<tr><td>2.1</td><td>B3, A2</td><td>receive A2</td></tr>
<tr><td>2.9</td><td>B3, A2, A3</td><td>receive A3</td></tr>
<tr><td>3.0</td><td>B3, A2, A3</td><td>finish sending B2</td></tr>

* flow A missed a turn because packet was just a little late
* intuition: should get extra turn to make up for this?
